source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the mangrove forest, printed page 244.

blocks.text: Inhein aksar "The Forests of the Sea" (samandar ke jangal) kaha jata hai. Yeh namak bardasht karne wale (salt-tolerant) jangal hain jo khushki aur samandar ke milap ki jagah par hote hain.

items: Location (jagah): Sindh (Indus River Delta mein Keti Bandar aur Mirpur Sakro ke mangroves) aur Balochistan ka sahil (Miani Hor, Kalmat Khor, Jiwani aur Gwatar Bay; kitab mein ‘Gawatar’ chhapa hai).

Abiotic Profile: Water (paani): brackish, yaani darya ka meetha aur samandar ka namkeen paani mila hua. Soil (mitti): anaerobic (oxygen ki kami wali) keechar (mudflats); is liye darakhton ki "breathing roots" (saans lene wali jarhein) hoti hain.
Key Flora (ahem paude): Avicennia marina (Timmar) jangal ka 95% hai.
Key Fauna (ahem janwar): Magarmachh (crocodiles), jheenge (shrimps), mudskippers, kekre (crabs), lobsters, kachhue, saanp, dolphins, aur flamingo, saaras (crane) aur pelican jaise parinde.

Current Status (maujooda haalat): Threatened (khatre mein), kyun ke Indus se meethe paani ka behao kam ho gaya hai aur Karachi ki aaloodgi aati hai; lekin haal ke bahali (restoration) ke mansoobon ne is ilaqe ko bachane mein madad di hai.

blocks.alt: Mangrove ka manzar. Avicennia marina ke darakht, gol surmayi-sabz chhatriyon ke saath, paani ki nahar ke kinare keechar (mudflat) par; keechar se pencil jaisi bohat si saans lene wali jarhein (breathing roots) upar nikli hain. Labels: darakhton mein bagle (herons) aur egrets, paani par battakhein, paani ke neeche jheenge aur keechar par kekre.
blocks.caption: Figure 25.14: Mangrove jangal aur us ke numainda paude aur janwar (kitab ki tasveer, Figure 25.14, ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki tasveer mein darakht mehraab jaisi tangon (stilt roots) par khare hain, jo Rhizophora jaise mangroves ki pehchaan hai. Lekin kitab ke mutabiq yahan ka 95% jangal Avicennia marina (timmar) hai, jis ki 'breathing roots' keechar se pencil ki tarah seedhi upar nikalti hain (pneumatophores). Is liye khaake mein yehi jarhein dikhai gayi hain; in se jarhein oxygen-kam keechar mein saans leti hain.

blocks.prompt: Mangrove forest ka ek paudha aur ek janwar batayein.
blocks.explanation: Maslan Avicennia marina (Timmar) aur mudskipper (ya magarmachh, kekra).

items: "Samandar ke jangal": khushki aur samandar ke milap par namak bardasht karne wale jangal.
Jagah: Indus Delta (Keti Bandar, Mirpur Sakro) aur Balochistan ka sahil; brackish paani, oxygen-kam keechar, breathing roots.
Paude: Avicennia marina (95%); janwar: magarmachh, jheenge, mudskippers, kekre, dolphins, flamingo. Haalat: threatened.
